manifest:
version: 1
agents:
  billing:
    runtime:
      id: openai-agents-sdk
    bindings:
      runtimeAgent:
        path: /src/agents.ts
        symbol: billingAgent
  triage:
    runtime:
      id: openai-agents-sdk
    bindings:
      runtimeAgent:
        path: /src/agents.ts
        symbol: triageAgent
      instructionLoader:
        path: /src/instructions.ts
        symbol: loadTriageInstruction
      outputSchema:
        path: /src/contracts.ts
        symbol: TriageOutputSchema
    tools:
      find-order:
        name: find_order
        description: Retrieves one order by its identifier.
        implementation:
          path: /src/find-order.ts
          symbol: findOrder
        registration:
          path: /src/tools.ts
          symbol: findOrderTool
        inputSchema:
          path: /src/contracts.ts
          symbol: FindOrderInputSchema
        outputSchema:
          path: /src/contracts.ts
          symbol: FindOrderOutputSchema

entries.text: Route billing questions and payment issues here.
export const findOrder = async (input: { orderId: string }) => ({ orderId: input.orderId });
export const loadTriageInstruction = async (): Promise<string> => 'Route the request.';
export const billingRoutingDescription = 'Route billing questions and payment issues here.';
